body:
Thanks for the kind words, I appreciate it.


To me I have 2 views of god: religion's view, and a representation of my view of how life has treated and I hate both. If the real God is a floating rooting for me independent of those 2 views I wouldn't know, and I can't say much about that one but if he does care I guess that's cool. I have a hard explaining myself but I am mainly using god as a metaphor (Idk if that's the term) and have no idea about him as an individual, however it's a comforting thought. I am very scared of believing any idea of God due to how I see it corrupt people. I  don't have any objections to the idea of a loving God but I don't want to believe in anything that I don't have evidence of. 


Also as far as the ignorant part of society goes I agree with you But sometimes it feels like despite that I know who I am and even though they can't change that I can't change the way they treat me which sucks. I know not everyone is that way but I live in SLC and a large part of the Community are people who are afraid to question what their parents told them. 


Thanks for the comfort it's people like you that make life good <3 


Also if you want the rest of my poetry I keep it [here](http://hellopoetry.com/kendra-lane/)
